title: Where have you been all my life????
text: Where have you been all my life????. My household drinks quite a bit of wine and one of the chores we hate the most is opening the bottle. I had never tried an electric opener before. This is a great device, right out of the box it is ready to go. Opens a bottle with a quick touch of a button. I will never go back to manually opening a wine bottle again (of course unless it is a screw cap, lol). Highly recommend to all. Comes in great packaging and would make a great unique gift for the wine lover in your life.

product_metadata.title: DOITSIPO Electric Wine Opener, Rechargeable Automatic Cordless Corkscrew with Foil Cutter and UBS Charging Cable, Compact, Black, for Wine Lover, 2pcs Wine Gift Set
features: [ Compact & Cordless ] Small size and cordless desigh make it more convenient to take out, such as barbecue, picinic, travel and party.

[ Fast & Quiet ] Open a bottle of wine in mere seconds with push-button ease and it makes less noise than other electric openers (less than 50 dB) during woking.
[ Rechargeable & Safety ] Open up to 50 wine bottles on a single charge. The screw head is made of food grade material, non-toxic and safe.
